body_html:
How to think about it

We get rice, wheat, dal, vegetables and fruits from plants, and milk, eggs, honey and fish from animals. Some foods such as cucumber and fruits can be eaten raw; others such as rice and dal are cooked by boiling, frying, steaming, roasting or baking.

People in different parts of India eat different foods, like idli in Tamil Nadu and dhokla in Gujarat, because different crops grow there. We should eat a balanced meal, wash our hands before eating and never waste food.

Example

Idli is cooked by…

in a special stand over water

Answer: steaming

Example

Is honey from a plant or an animal?

bees make it

Answer: an animal

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all food comes from shops.
  • Thinking milk comes from plants.
  • Wasting food on the plate.
